dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Overview of watchlists, asset coverage, and open alerts.

onboarding.headline: Welcome — let's get set up
onboarding.intro: We'll walk through the inputs that drive every buy / sell signal: fundamentals, news, market trend, technical analysis, AI — combined into a probability-weighted recommendation that only fires when the NET return (after fees and capital-gains tax) clears your minimum.
onboarding.revisitHint: You can revisit and change every value later under Settings. The dashboard shows your remaining steps so you can finish at any time.

mfa.label: Two-factor authentication
mfa.description: Protects the account that holds broker credentials and trading actions.

alpaca.label: Broker (Alpaca)
alpaca.description: Required for portfolio reads and (later) automated execution.

trading.label: Trading defaults
trading.description: Broker fees and your minimum net yield drive every recommendation.

taxes.label: Capital-gains tax
taxes.description: Subtracted from projected gains so recommendations only fire when the NET return clears your minimum.

tour.headline: Guided first run
tour.intro: One full pass through the decision process - with real actions in the real application, not a preview.
tour.whatYouWillDo: What you will do in this run
tour.noRealMoney: No real money moves in this run. The trade at the end is a paper trade, and automated execution stays switched off.

evidence.config: Counts as done once the values are set in Settings.
evidence.visited: Counts as done once the page actually loaded - a click alone is not enough.
evidence.created: Counts as done once a new entry was created during this run. Anything that existed before deliberately does not count.
evidence.acknowledged: Counts as done once you finish the run.

basics.label: Basic settings
basics.description: Fees and taxes decide whether a recommendation is actionable at all. Without them the net yield gate is meaningless.
watchFor: Absolute and percentage order fee, the way your broker charges them
Capital gains tax - it co-decides the net return
Minimum target yield: below it nothing is reported as actionable

findSymbol.label: Find a symbol
findSymbol.description: The scanner lists candidates from your watchlists with price, change and data source.
watchFor: Data source column: real provider data or placeholder
Asset class per row - stock, ETF or crypto
Clicking a symbol takes you straight into the analysis

readAnalysis.label: Read the analysis
readAnalysis.description: This is where the recommendation is formed. Every axis is shown separately so the verdict stays traceable.
watchFor: Overall verdict BUY/HOLD/SELL and each axis's contribution
P(UP) with its source - the technical ML ensemble, not the news
Net yield gate: is the trade worth it after fees and tax
Warning banner on synthetic data - no signal is given on purpose then

watchlist.label: Add it to a watchlist
watchlist.description: Watched symbols feed the scanner, news and alerts. Create your own entry now.
watchFor: Create your own list or add a symbol to an existing one
Starter lists are just an initial filling and may be deleted
Tags help with filtering and prioritising later

alert.label: Create an alert rule
alert.description: Rules speak up when a condition is met, so you do not have to keep checking yourself.
watchFor: Define the condition and its threshold
Triggered events are acknowledged, not silently dropped
Push delivery additionally needs the browser's permission

paperTrade.label: Place a paper trade
paperTrade.description: The whole trading path without capital at risk: order, position, journal and summary.
watchFor: Place an order and find it again in the journal
Check position and summary after execution
The net yield gate may reject an order for a stated reason

autoExecution.label: Understand automation
autoExecution.description: Automated execution can trade proposals on its own. It stays off in this run - switching it on is a separate decision.
watchFor: The composite gate can only block, never trigger a trade by itself
Limits per order, per day and per position bound the damage
Defaults stay off until you explicitly enable them

paperTrading.title: Paper trading
paperTrading.subtitle: Place simulated orders against your watchlist universe. The Net-Yield-Gate applies the same fee + tax math as live recommendations.

form.title: Place order
form.rejectionDetail: Net target {{net}}% below required {{minimum}}% (gross {{gross}}%, fees {{fees}}%, tax {{tax}}%).

openOrders.empty: No open orders. Place one above.

journal.empty: No transactions yet. Filled orders appear here in chronological order.
journal.emptyInRange: No transactions in the selected time range. Switch to a wider range to see older trades.

events.title: Events
events.unsupported: This asset class has no earnings, dividends or splits — no data is missing here.
events.unconfigured: No FMP access configured. Earnings, dividends and splits stay empty until an administrator sets the key under Admin - Platform configuration.
events.unavailable: The provider returned no earnings, dividends or splits for this symbol.

composite.title: Overall verdict
composite.subtitle: all sources weighted
composite.coverageNote: Only {{available}} of {{total}} axes returned data. The verdict rests on {{percent}}% of the intended signal weight; the missing axes carry no weight and are shown as 0%.

synthetic.title: No real market data — placeholder values
synthetic.body: No data provider returned prices for this symbol. The chart, indicators and patterns are based on synthetic placeholder values. No buy/sell recommendation is given on purpose. Configure a suitable provider API key (e.g. Alpaca, Alpha Vantage) to see real data.

modelPerformance.title: Model performance
modelPerformance.subtitle: Walk-forward backtest of the persisted predictor over the last {{count}} predicted bars{{trained}}.
modelPerformance.calibrationHint: Predicted P(UP) bucket vs actual UP-rate. A well-calibrated model has actual ≈ predicted across buckets.

dataQuality.title: Data quality
dataQuality.subtitle: Which provider answered for which field. The recommendation rests on this — the badge below the prediction reflects the same overall confidence.
dataQuality.upgradeHints: Upgrade hints — these would improve the data foundation for this symbol

researchSignals.title: Research signals
researchSignals.subtitle: Insider activity, institutional ownership, earnings beat history, next earnings.

earningsCalls.title: Earnings call digest
earningsCalls.subtitle: VADER-scored summary of the most recent transcripts (FMP). Each card shows the highest- and lowest-scoring sentence as concrete quotes.
earningsCalls.noSnippets: Transcript scored {{score}} but no eligible sentences passed the snippet filter.

macroContext.title: Macro context
macroContext.subtitle: Market-wide weather report. Read every per-symbol signal in this context.

cryptoMetrics.title: Crypto metrics
cryptoMetrics.subtitle: Market depth, ATH/ATL distance, developer + community activity (CoinGecko).

socialSentiment.title: Retail sentiment
socialSentiment.subtitle: Combined StockTwits + Reddit chatter from the last 24 hours.

sectorStrength.title: Sector relative strength
sectorStrength.subtitle: Trailing return spread vs SPY/QQQ/IWM and the matching sector ETF; correlation and beta against SPY for the last 90 trading days.
sectorStrength.peerCountHelp: Benchmarks + sector ETF compared against this symbol

secFilings.title: SEC filings
secFilings.subtitle: EDGAR filings index from FMP — annual (10-K), quarterly (10-Q), material events (8-K), proxy statements (DEF 14A) and offerings.

prediction.probabilitiesUnavailable: No directional probabilities for this data situation — none are shown rather than derived ones that would contradict the verdict.

news.title: News hub
news.subtitle: Headlines from every configured provider — Alpaca + FMP + Alpha Vantage news plus curated RSS feeds (boerse.de, ariva.de, Reuters). Filter by source, sentiment, time window, or symbol to find new tickers worth a closer look.
news.matchSummary: {{count}} items match the filters · sources active: {{sources}}
news.empty: No news matches the current filters.

discover.title: Discover
discover.subtitle: Tickers worth a closer look — trending in the news right now, biggest movers today, and insider activity clusters from the last 90 days. Click any symbol to jump into its analysis page.

trending.title: Trending in the news
trending.subtitle: Symbols mentioned in the global news feed over the last 24 h, ranked by mention count. The trend percent compares against the previous 6-day baseline; the sentiment-burst delta tells you whether the chatter is shifting bullish or bearish.
trending.empty: No trending tickers in the last news cycle.

movers.title: Top movers today
movers.subtitle: Today's gainers, losers, and most-active US tickers (FMP). The most-active column doubles as a starting point for unusual-volume scenarios.

clusters.title: Insider clusters
clusters.subtitle: Symbols where 3+ unique insiders filed transactions in the last 90 days, ranked by insider count and absolute net value. A "buy cluster" with a large positive net value is one of the strongest non-public signals you can read.
clusters.empty: No insider clusters in the last 90 days — or FMP unconfigured.

docs.noTopic: No help available for this page yet.

pwa.updateAvailable: A new version of NexusPulse Trade is ready.

autoExecution.title: Auto-execution
autoExecution.subtitle: Phase 4 risk model + automation kill-switch. Every proposed automated trade has to clear all risk gates AND the halt-trigger checks AND the Net-Yield-Gate. The master switch ships disabled — turn it on only after configuring the limits below.
autoExecution.statusEnabledPaperHelp: Every 15 minutes the loop walks your watchlist, evaluates each symbol against all risk gates and halt triggers, and books matching trades into the internal paper book. NO Alpaca calls — no real money moves.
autoExecution.statusEnabledLiveHelp: WARNING: matching trades go to the configured Alpaca account. Phase 4e ships paper-mode validated; live-mode lives behind a separate gate that you flipped on intentionally.
autoExecution.statusDisabledHelp: No order will be placed automatically. Turn the switch on to opt in.
autoExecution.modePaperHint: Routes accepted proposals into the internal paper-trading book. No Alpaca, no real money.
autoExecution.modeLiveHint: Routes accepted proposals to your configured Alpaca account. Real money moves.
autoExecution.modeLiveLockedHint: Live mode is hard-locked in code until Phase 4f delivers a real broker adapter (Trade Republic, Flatex, Comdirect, Bitvavo, …). Cannot be enabled by accident.

limits.title: Risk limits
limits.compositeGateHelp: Only auto-trade when the composite decision score agrees with the ML direction and clears the confidence bar below. Can only block trades, never trigger new ones.

events.title: Recent automation events
events.subtitle: Every evaluation, halt, and execution leaves an audit row here.

confirmEnable.title: Enable automation?
confirmEnable.body: I understand that turning this on permits the system to evaluate, accept, and (in future phases) place real broker orders within the limits I configured. The halt button stops everything immediately.

confirmHalt.title: Stop all automation?
confirmHalt.body: This disables the master switch and audits the halt event. Any open Alpaca limit orders will be canceled in Phase 4d reconciliation.

confirmLiveMode.title: Switch to live mode?
confirmLiveMode.body: Live mode routes accepted proposals to your configured Alpaca account. Real money will move. Validate the paper loop end-to-end first; flip this only when you trust the system.

macroCalendar.title: Macro calendar
macroCalendar.unconfigured: FRED_API_KEY not configured — set one in .env.local to surface treasury yields, commodities, and upcoming CPI/NFP/FOMC release dates.

composite.verdict: The overall BUY/HOLD/SELL call, combining every source with visible weights — not a guarantee. See each axis's contribution below.
composite.score: Weighted mean of the available axes, from -1 (bearish) to +1 (bullish). Its magnitude is the confidence.
composite.technical: The ML model's price-direction signal from chart indicators — today the only historically back-tested axis.
composite.analyst: Analyst consensus stance and price-target upside. Policy-weighted until enough forward data calibrates it.
composite.fundamentals: Valuation health (P/E, ROE, debt). Policy-weighted until enough forward data calibrates it.
composite.news: Aggregated news-sentiment freshness. Policy-weighted until enough forward data calibrates it.

prediction.probabilityUp: The ML ensemble's estimated probability that the price rises over the next bar. 50% means no edge.
prediction.netYield: Expected return AFTER broker fees and capital-gains tax. Only a positive net yield counts as actionable.
prediction.zones: Suggested entry, stop-loss and target levels derived from volatility (ATR) and support/resistance.

autoExecution.compositeGate: When on, an auto-trade also needs the composite verdict to agree with the ML direction and clear the confidence bar below. It can only block trades, never start new ones.
autoExecution.minCompositeConfidence: Minimum composite confidence (|score|, 0–1) required before an auto-trade fires.
autoExecution.maxPositionSize: Largest USD amount a single automated order may use.
autoExecution.maxDailyLoss: Automation stops for the day once realised losses reach this amount.
autoExecution.maxOpenPositions: Automation won't open more than this many positions at once.
autoExecution.maxBeta: Skip symbols more volatile than this beta versus SPY.

admin.weights: Relative weight of each source in the composite verdict. Normalised to 100%.
admin.readiness: How much labeled forward-collected data exists. The full 4-axis calibration turns on once enough accrues.
admin.calibrate: Grid-searches the weights against the realised hit-rate on collected data. Writes new weights only when they beat the current ones.

alerts.title: Alert rules and events
alerts.subtitle: Granular per-symbol rules. Open events stay until acknowledged.

form.name: Name (optional)
form.thresholdRequired: A price target needs a threshold — without one the rule would never fire.

watchlists.subtitle: Lists are stored per user. Starter lists are seeded when the account is created.

alpaca.title: Alpaca broker
alpaca.subtitle: Used for portfolio reads and (later) order placement. Secret key is encrypted at rest and never returned in plaintext after save.

portfolio.title: Portfolio defaults & taxes
portfolio.subtitle: Used to project net yield. The system only flags a trade as actionable when the projected net return (after broker fees and capital-gains tax) clears your minimum.
portfolio.taxHint: Capital-gains rate dominates if both are set; income-tax fallback is only used when the broker treats short-term gains as ordinary income.

mfa.setupHint: Add this account to your authenticator app, then enter a generated code to confirm.

notifications.hint: Price targets and signal alerts reach you even when this page is closed. The browser asks for permission once.
